window_frame.note: The surrounding two-point hard frame is Threading's clean-room Classic Player material. A .wsz supplies player bitmaps, not a resizable macOS window frame.

title_bar.note: Two independent compatible implementations pin the classic TITLEBAR.BMP sheet, its 275x14 active and inactive bands, and its top-left source coordinates. Threading reads user-supplied artwork locally and preserves both hardware ends while extending only the centre groove.

window_buttons.note: Webamp's sprite table and Audacious's loader independently establish the 9x9 options, minimize, shade and close states. Threading maps those images onto semantic window menu, minimize, zoom/restore and delegate-consulted close actions.

toolbar.note: This feature skins Threading's window chrome, not the original player's application toolbar or playback controls.

buttons.note: Application buttons use the authored Classic Player material; user skin bitmaps are never stretched across unrelated controls.

choice_controls.note: Choice controls use Threading's square, bevelled material and are outside the TITLEBAR compatibility slice.

fields.note: Fields use Threading's authored dark player material and are outside the imported skin slice.

menus.note: The options sprite opens Threading's own window operations menu. No menu code or menu pixels are loaded from the archive.

popovers.note: Popovers use the shared compact period style; the .wsz title-band artwork does not reach transient UI.

scrollbars.note: Classic player playlist scrollbars are outside this window-chrome import and are not projected onto Threading content.

lists_tables.note: Playlist artwork is outside this window-chrome import and is not projected onto Threading lists.

progress.note: Playback-position and volume sprites are application controls, not window chrome, and are not loaded.

alerts_toasts.note: Alerts remain Threading surfaces in the authored Classic Player material.

typography.note: An imported band contains its own baked title pixels. Elsewhere the clean-room stock theme uses the system monospaced design and imports no font.

icons.note: No Winamp logo or icon ships with Threading. The imported title sheet remains a user-owned local theme asset.
